summary: Compared software adapter and installed outer profile against the requested existing-game workflow. Verified preserved Git/layout/wiki authority, scoped evidence records, real failing/stale-input tests, standalone and wrapper use, current docs, generated cross-links, 31 strict harness tests and 21,258 existing domain assertions. This is developer self-review, not independent IA or M0 acceptance.

acceptance.criterion: Shared root and standalone game entry points
acceptance.evidence: management/evidence/pm-integration/root-entry-20261111T070809539126Z.log; standalone CLI and wrapper covered by 13 adapter tests.
management/evidence/pm-integration/overlay-20261111T070809419305Z.log; temporary-root tests preserve original strict content and reject malformed blocks.

acceptance.criterion: Real check evidence and stale-input completion guards
acceptance.evidence: management/evidence/pm-integration/tests-20261111T070645222429Z.log; failures, stale inputs, modified logs, missing checks, review receipts and acceptance coverage are tested.

acceptance.criterion: Preserved game wiki and documentation consistency
acceptance.evidence: management/evidence/pm-integration/docs-20261111T071004362916Z.log; management/evidence/pm-integration/wiki-build-20261111T070659209576Z.log; management/evidence/pm-integration/wiki-check-20261111T070821690887Z.log; inspected generated management, development, guide and contract pages for reciprocal links and current limits.

acceptance.criterion: Existing game and strict harness remain separate
acceptance.evidence: management/evidence/pm-integration/game-domain-20261111T070907068525Z.log; management/evidence/pm-integration/strict-harness-regression.log; existing game Git root and .github workflow retained; original strict runtime and registry unchanged.

limitations: Checks hash declared task inputs only; completeness and semantic claims require human/developer review.
One coordinator/CLI mutation at a time; this is not a concurrent task service.
Self-review is not independent assurance or strict-harness certification.
Only the small outer overlay is versioned in the game repository; restoring the generic outer harness still requires its separate distribution.
Proposed backlog entries are not approved scope, and existing game milestone gaps remain open.
